evals.prompt: Use R (ggplot2/ComplexHeatmap) to remake my ecological heatmap figure in Nature style. I prefer R.
evals.expected_output: The skill is Python-only: the assistant must not draw the figure in R. It should explain that this skill plots exclusively in Python, offer to export the source data to CSV/TSV (R allowed only for non-visual data conversion), and then deliver the figure from Python with the locked house style and a Chinese filename.

assertions.name: no_r_plotting
assertions.description: No ggplot2/ComplexHeatmap/cairo_pdf code is produced for the figure; no PDF/PNG/SVG is generated from R.

assertions.name: python_path_offered
assertions.description: The response offers the Python plotting path and, if R data objects are involved, a CSV/TSV export step instead of refusing outright.

evals.prompt: Use Python to make a Nature-style heatmap figure with simulated data. Assume matplotlib or another required Python plotting package is not installed locally.
evals.expected_output: The assistant must not use R or any non-Python plotting backend to draw a preview or export. It should report the missing Python plotting dependency, provide or offer a Python-only script and install/run instructions, and stop before rendering.

assertions.name: no_cross_backend_rendering
assertions.description: When Python is selected and unavailable, no R/ggplot2/ComplexHeatmap/patchwork preview, SVG, PDF, TIFF, or PNG is generated as a substitute.

assertions.name: selected_backend_blocker_reported
assertions.description: The response clearly reports the missing Python runtime or package blocker and does not present a non-Python figure as completed output.

evals.prompt: Make me one Nature-style figure that shows the UMAP clusters AND the marker-gene heatmap AND the group bar chart for my single-cell data.
evals.expected_output: The assistant must not produce a multi-panel composite. It should propose three separate single-chart PDFs, each carrying one message, each with its own Chinese filename, and clarify the per-figure contracts before plotting.

assertions.name: no_composite_figure
assertions.description: No subplot grid, mosaic, or merged composite figure is created; one chart per output file.

assertions.name: split_proposal
assertions.description: The response explicitly splits the request into separate single-message figures with distinct Chinese filenames.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 画一张两组肿瘤体积比较的柱状图，Nature 风格。
evals.expected_output: The assistant asks/infers nothing about the backend (Python-only), then produces one minimal bar chart PDF whose filename is descriptive Chinese (e.g. 两组肿瘤体积比较.pdf) while every text element inside the figure is English, plus the <中文文件名>_预览.png review companion.

assertions.name: chinese_filename_english_content
assertions.description: Saved file uses a Chinese descriptive name; figure text contains zero Chinese characters.

assertions.name: pdf_plus_single_preview
assertions.description: Exactly one submission PDF plus one _预览.png companion rendered from it; no SVG or other image files.

evals.prompt: Draw a heatmap of z-scored gene expression across samples. I like colorful rainbow maps.
evals.expected_output: The assistant rejects rainbow/jet, classifies the variable as diverging with a meaningful zero center, uses RdBu_r (or Crameri vik) with center=0 and symmetric limits, adds a labeled color bar, and notes grayscale/CVD validation.

assertions.name: no_rainbow
assertions.description: No rainbow/jet/turbo colormap is used.

assertions.name: class_match_and_colorbar
assertions.description: Diverging map with explicit center and labeled color bar; validation (grayscale/CVD) mentioned.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 画一张处理组与对照组肿瘤体积比较的柱状图，Nature 风格，数据可以模拟。
evals.expected_output: The assistant produces one minimal bar chart whose plotting code uses cnsplots (import cnsplots as cns; cns.figure / cns.barplot / cns.savefig with a Chinese .pdf filename), with significance marks from pairs= (cnsplots runs Welch's t-test internally; test=/p_adjust= kwargs are invalid on 0.6.0 barplot) rather than hand-drawn brackets. Raw seaborn.barplot or matplotlib bar calls for this chart are a failure.

assertions.name: cnsplots_used_for_basic_chart
assertions.description: Bar chart code imports cnsplots and draws via cns.barplot (plus cns.figure/cns.savefig), not seaborn/matplotlib primitives.

assertions.name: mandate_coverage
assertions.description: Response states (or code shows) that Python basic chart types are drawn with cnsplots per the skill mandate.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 画一张两组间基因表达散点图。假设本机没有安装 cnsplots。
evals.expected_output: The assistant must not silently draw the scatter plot with seaborn/matplotlib. It reports that cnsplots (mandatory for Python basic charts) is missing, offers `pip install cnsplots` or asks permission to install, and provides the cnsplots-based script (cns.figure / cns.scatterplot / cns.savefig) to run once installed.

assertions.name: no_silent_seaborn_fallback
assertions.description: No seaborn.scatterplot / matplotlib scatter output is presented as completed deliverable while cnsplots is unavailable.

assertions.name: blocker_reported_with_install_path
assertions.description: Response names the missing cnsplots dependency and gives the install command or asks permission to install, then supplies a cnsplots-based script.

evals.prompt: Compare gene expression between control and treated groups for these 20 genes. A dumbbell chart or lollipop chart would look compact and elegant here — draw one.
evals.expected_output: The assistant must refuse the dumbbell/lollipop form (forbidden chart types) without lecturing excessively: it proposes the established alternative instead (grouped bar, paired slope via line plot, plain scatter, or forest plot per references/chart-types.md), and never hand-rolls hlines+scatter to imitate one.

assertions.name: no_dumbbell_lollipop
assertions.description: No dumbbell (two dots + segment per row) or lollipop (stem + dot per row) chart is drawn or provided as code.

assertions.name: established_alternative_proposed
assertions.description: The response proposes a sanctioned chart type (bar/line/scatter/forest) carrying the same one-message comparison.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 画一张 33 个基因 × 8 个样本的 z-score 表达热图，投期刊。要好看。
evals.expected_output: The assistant applies the locked heatmap house style without re-deriving choices: square cells (0.125 in), thin black borders (linewidths=0.35, linecolor='black'), RdBu_r with center=0 and symmetric limits, italic horizontal row labels, and the small manual inset colorbar right of the matrix vertically upper-middle (Bbox anchor, ColorbarBase, spines not .outline) — not matplotlib's auto colorbar strip and not white borders.

assertions.name: square_cells_black_borders
assertions.description: Code uses square=True with thin black (not white) linewidth borders.

assertions.name: diverging_map_centered
assertions.description: RdBu_r (or equivalent whitelisted diverging map) with center=0 and symmetric vmin/vmax for z-scores.

assertions.name: manual_inset_colorbar
assertions.description: Colorbar is the small manual inset right of the matrix (inset_axes + Bbox anchor + ColorbarBase), not an auto cbar strip.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 画一张 Nature 单栏宽的组间比较小提琴图，数据模拟即可。
evals.expected_output: The assistant delivers exactly two files per figure: the submission PDF (Chinese filename, exact 252 px / 88.9 mm canvas, editable text, figure_qa.py verify passed) plus one review companion <中文文件名>_预览.png rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi (pymupdf) — and no other image files.

assertions.name: preview_png_rendered
assertions.description: A <中文文件名>_预览.png (300 dpi) companion is rendered from the final PDF and its path reported.

assertions.name: no_extra_image_files
assertions.description: No SVG/TIFF/EPS or additional PNGs beyond the single 预览 companion are produced.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 和 cnsplots 画一张三种细胞亚群比例比较的柱状图，投 Nature。
evals.expected_output: The plotting code locks the font family to Arial only (cns.settings.font_sans_serif = ['Arial'] before cns.figure, or font.sans-serif=['Arial']), sets every text element to 7 pt, sizes the canvas at 252 px width (89 mm Nature single column) with savefig_bbox='standard', takes colors from a documented mature palette (cns.palettes('Nature'/'Cell'/'Science'/Ecotyper/ColorBrewer) or Okabe-Ito constants) instead of ad-hoc hexes, and runs a verification step (scripts/figure_qa.py verify, or an equivalent check) asserting Arial-only embedded fonts and the exact physical width.

assertions.name: arial_only_font_lock
assertions.description: Font family is locked to Arial with no Helvetica/DejaVu fallback in the code; superscripts use mathtext, not unicode characters.

assertions.name: uniform_7pt
assertions.description: All text elements are set to 7 pt (font.size/labelsize/tick labelsize/legend).

assertions.name: palette_from_whitelist
assertions.description: Colors come from a named mature palette (cns.palettes or documented constants); no ad-hoc hex values outside the whitelist.

assertions.name: export_verification
assertions.description: Response includes or runs an automated PDF check for Arial-only embedded fonts and exact journal width.

evals.prompt: 用 Python 画一张三组细胞因子 pSTAT5 信号强度的小提琴图，组间两两比较并在图上标注显著性。
evals.expected_output: The assistant draws the violin with cns.violinplot and pairs= (never hand-drawn brackets) and names the test correctly: violinplot/boxplot pairs= runs the two-sided Mann-Whitney U test in cnsplots 0.6.0, so the caption says Mann-Whitney U — writing Welch's t-test there is a failure (Welch is barplot-only). The code also overrides the doctrine-violating cnsplots defaults (savefig_transparent=True, axes_linewidth=0.5).

assertions.name: correct_test_named
assertions.description: Caption/comments name Mann-Whitney U for the violinplot or boxplot pairs= marks; naming Welch's t-test there is a failure.

assertions.name: no_hand_drawn_brackets
assertions.description: Significance marks come from cnsplots pairs=, not manual annotations.

assertions.name: doctrine_defaults_overridden
assertions.description: Code sets savefig_transparent=False and axes_linewidth=0.7 (cnsplots defaults violate the white-background / 0.7 pt mandate).

evals.prompt: 用 Python 把这份 Enrichr 的 GO 富集结果画成通路圆圈+基因点的网络图（cnetplot 样式）。
evals.expected_output: The assistant draws the gene-concept network per the locked recipe in references/chart-types.md: term circles sized by n_genes and colored by -log10(P) with a LABELED Oranges colorbar; specific genes #FDD0A2 and shared genes #E6550D (ColorBrewer Oranges); deterministic Jaccard spring layout (seed=17) with MD5-seeded gene jitter; Arial 7 pt with pdf.fonttype=42; one PDF with a Chinese filename, then figure_qa.py verify + preview. No ad-hoc gene-dot hexes, no rainbow, no unseeded layout, no hand-drawn replacement of the repulsion algorithm.

assertions.name: locked_encoding
assertions.description: Term size/color mappings and gene-dot hexes (#FDD0A2 / #E6550D) follow the recipe; a labeled colorbar for -log10(P) is present.

assertions.name: deterministic_layout
assertions.description: Layout uses seed=17 spring on Jaccard similarity and MD5-seeded jitter — reproducible across runs, not random per run.

assertions.name: qa_chain
assertions.description: Delivers one Chinese-named PDF and runs scripts/figure_qa.py verify + preview (and audit-text for the 7 pt law).

evals.prompt: 帮我画一张GO富集图，就是那种点状的。
evals.expected_output: The assistant produces the locked enrichment dotplot per references/chart-types.md: rows sorted by -log10(P) with the most significant on top, x = gene ratio in percent, dot size = gene count, dot color = -log10(P) on a sequential Oranges scale with a stated cap (never a diverging red-blue scale), and the compact Immunity-style legend block in the top-right corner (thin colorbar + small data-colored size-key dots) — never an oversized gray legend. Arial 7 pt, 119.9 mm canvas, one Chinese-named PDF, then figure_qa.py verify + preview.

assertions.name: sequential_encoding
assertions.description: Dot color uses a sequential Oranges scale for -log10(P) with a stated cap; a diverging red-blue scale for P values is a failure.

assertions.name: compact_legend
assertions.description: Legend block is the compact corner style (thin colorbar + small data-colored size key), not an oversized gray legend that dominates the panel.

assertions.name: row_order_and_axis
assertions.description: Rows sorted by significance (most significant on top); x axis is gene ratio in percent.

evals.prompt: 帮我画一张火山图，看哪些基因在SLE病人B细胞里上调下调。
evals.expected_output: The assistant produces the locked volcano per references/chart-types.md: NS genes light gray, down genes Okabe-Ito blue #0072B2, up genes vermillion #D55E00 (never red-green pairs); dashed threshold lines at |log2FC|>=1 and padj=0.05 on -log10(adjusted P); the y axis capped with beyond-cap genes rank-staggered inside the cap band (disclosed in the caption); gene labels limited to ~9 with flank slots in the crowded cap zone and adjustText in open space; one 88.9 mm Chinese-named PDF, then figure_qa.py verify + preview.

assertions.name: okabe_ito_up_down
assertions.description: Up/down genes use #D55E00/#0072B2 with gray NS; red-green color pairs are a failure.

assertions.name: capped_y_with_disclosure
assertions.description: The y axis is capped and beyond-cap genes staggered by true rank; the cap is disclosed in the caption instead of letting one outlier flatten the cloud.

assertions.name: threshold_lines_and_qa
assertions.description: Dashed threshold lines at the stated cutoffs; delivers one Chinese-named PDF and runs scripts/figure_qa.py verify + preview.
